UnorderedLister.template: An item in an unordered list starts with a dash "- ". Generate an unordered list based on the following: "{list}".

OrderedLister.template: An item in an ordered list starts with a number "1. ". Generate an ordered list based on the following: "{list}".

Checker.template: In the following text: "{text}", check that the following condition is satisfied: "{condition}". Answer only True or False.

Evaluator.template: In the following text: "{text}", evaluate the criteria: "{criteria}".

Critic.template: Criticize the following text: "{text}" according to the following criteria: "{criteria}".

Arguer.template: Argue the following point: "{goal}" in response to the following: "{text}".
